claims.text: At the Coronation Royal Luncheon the Prime Minister addresses King George Tupou V and guests gathered 'today' to celebrate the Coronation of the King, 'the formal coronation of our King', and refers to 'today's Coronation'. The page ends with the dateline 'From the office of the Prime Minister,Nuku'alofa, Tomnga, 1 August 2008' [as printed].
claims.uncertainty: Dated by the page's own dateline; the PMO programme, which places the Royal Luncheon at 13:00 on 1 August 2008, corroborates it. A same-day address, not a ceremony record.

claims.text: The same address says that 'On Wednesday this week' the King received the ancient kingly title Tu'i Kanokupolu, as the 23rd Tu'i Kanokupolu, at his traditional investiture, the taumafa kava ceremony.
claims.uncertainty: No structured date: 'Wednesday this week' is relative to the 1 August 2008 dateline. It corroborates the traditional installation recorded by to_crown_gtv_taumafa_kava_held_20080730 and is not a separate event.
